full_judgment: 2. The suit was filed on 19-2-68 by M/s. Hardeo Glass, Aluminium, Enamel and Silicate Works, an enemy firm represented by East Pakistan Small Industries Corporation (hereinafter referred to as the 'EPSIC' for a decree of a sum of Taka 7, 24,559.20 on account of loan advanced and money spent on miscellaneous accounts by the plaintiff opposite party for the defendant-petitioner. The EPSIC was appointed as agent of the plaintiff firm under rule 181 of the Defense of Pakistan Rules, 1965 by Notification No. Sec-28/65- EPS/125 dated 6-10-1965. Thereafter the Vice-Chairman of the East Pakistan Enemy Property Management Board vested the plaintiff's property in the Additional Custodian of Enemy Property by Notification dated 13-7-68 under rule 182(1) of the Defense of Pakistan Rule 1965 cancelling the aforesaid Notification dated 6-10-65.
